from auth import authenticate


def test_expired_token_returns_401_expired():
    result = authenticate("expired")
    assert result == (401, "expired")
    assert type(result) is tuple
    assert type(result[0]) is int
    assert result[0] == 401
    assert type(result[1]) is str
    assert result[1] == "expired"


def test_expired_token_does_not_return_500():
    status, message = authenticate("expired")
    assert status != 500
    assert status == 401
    assert message == "expired"


def test_valid_token_behavior_preserved():
    result = authenticate("valid")
    assert result == (200, "alice")
    assert type(result) is tuple
    assert type(result[0]) is int
    assert type(result[1]) is str


def test_absent_token_behavior_preserved():
    result = authenticate(None)
    assert result == (401, "missing")
    assert type(result) is tuple
    assert type(result[0]) is int
    assert type(result[1]) is str

patches.rationale: The expired-token branch in `authenticate` returns `(500, "expired")`; the issue requires `(401, "expired")`. Change only that branch, preserving the valid-token `(200, "alice")` and absent-token `(401, "missing")` behaviors. Add a NEW regression test file covering the expired contract plus the preserved behaviors.
